name: May
title: Where to go on holiday in May
intro: May is one of the best months to travel: Europe is warm, the summer crowds haven't arrived, and prices are lower than in July and August. Here's where's at its best.
seo_title: Where is hot in May? Early summer sun and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
May is one of the best months of the year to go away. Southern Europe is warm, mostly in the mid twenties, the days are long, and the summer crowds and prices haven't arrived. Seville and Marrakech are already close to 30°C, the Greek islands and Turkey are in the mid twenties, and even northern cities like Paris and Prague are around 20°C.

The catch is the sea, which is still warming up: around 18 to 20°C in most of the Mediterranean. It's swimmable for most people by the end of the month, especially in the east.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for May, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London. Everywhere at its best in May is listed above.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The warmest places within about five hours of the UK:

- **1. [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) and [Seville](/destinations/seville):** around 28 to 29°C, getting hot. 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours 30 minutes.
- **2. [Jordan](/destinations/jordan):** around 28°C, the last comfortable month for Petra before summer. About 5 hours.
- **3. [Antalya](/destinations/antalya), [Athens](/destinations/athens) and [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** around 26°C. 3 hours 30 minutes to 6 hours.
- **4. [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Corfu](/destinations/corfu), [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Paphos](/destinations/paphos):** around 25°C. 2 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **5. [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Malta](/destinations/malta), [Split](/destinations/split) and [Valencia](/destinations/valencia):** around 24°C. 2 to 4 hours.
- **6. [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Dubrovnik](/destinations/dubrovnik), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve), [Santorini](/destinations/santorini) and the [Amalfi Coast](/destinations/amalfi-coast):** around 23°C. 2 to 4 hours.
- **7. [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote):** around 24 to 25°C, but they're past their best season. About 4 hours.

sections.heading: Beaches before the crowds
sections.text:
May is the first month of the year when a Mediterranean beach holiday works well, and it's much cheaper than July or August.

- **Greece:** [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Corfu](/destinations/corfu) and [Zakynthos](/destinations/zakynthos) are around 24 to 25°C. The islands are open, green and quiet.
- **Turkey:** [Antalya](/destinations/antalya), [Bodrum](/destinations/bodrum) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas) are some of the warmest beach spots in May.
- **Spain:** [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Ibiza](/destinations/ibiza) and [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) are around 23 to 25°C, warm enough for the beach, though the sea is still fresh.
- **Croatia and Montenegro:** [Split](/destinations/split), [Dubrovnik](/destinations/dubrovnik) and [Kotor](/destinations/kotor) are around 23 to 24°C, and much calmer than in summer.

The sea is warmest in the east, around Cyprus and southern Turkey. Our [beach holidays](/destinations/beach-holidays) page has the full list.

sections.heading: Cities, lakes and mountains
sections.text:
May is warm enough for long days of sightseeing almost everywhere in Europe, without the heat that makes July hard work in Rome or Seville. [Florence](/destinations/florence) and [Rome](/destinations/rome) are around 23 to 24°C, [Budapest](/destinations/budapest) and [Vienna](/destinations/vienna) around 21 to 22°C, and [Paris](/destinations/paris), [Prague](/destinations/prague) and [Berlin](/destinations/berlin) around 19 to 20°C.

The Italian lakes are at their best, with gardens in flower around [Lake Como](/destinations/lake-como) and [Lake Garda](/destinations/lake-garda) at around 22 to 23°C. Further north, the [Norwegian fjords](/destinations/norwegian-fjords) have long days and waterfalls at full flow from the snowmelt, though it's still cool, around 14°C.

sections.heading: May half term
sections.text: May half term, at the end of the month, is the start of the busy season, but it's still much cheaper than the summer holidays. Greece, Turkey, Mallorca and the Algarve are all warm enough for the beach by then. Book early for the most popular islands, and check whether your hotel's pools are heated. Our [May half term](/destinations/may-half-term-holidays) page has more ideas.

sections.heading: Long-haul in May
sections.text:
May is the start of the rainy season in much of the Caribbean, Mexico and Thailand, so the long-haul choice narrows. The best bets are:

- **[Bali](/destinations/bali)** and **[Borneo](/destinations/borneo):** dry season is starting, around 31 to 32°C.
- **[Seychelles](/destinations/seychelles)** and **[Mauritius](/destinations/mauritius):** calm seas and around 27 to 30°C.
- **The USA:** [Orlando](/destinations/orlando) is hot before the summer storms, [New York](/destinations/new-york) and [Washington DC](/destinations/washington-dc) are around 22 to 25°C, and the [Utah national parks](/destinations/utah-national-parks) are comfortable before the summer heat.
- **Japan:** [Tokyo](/destinations/tokyo) is around 23°C, after the cherry blossom and before the rainy season.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
For the most reliable beach weather with a short flight, go east: Crete, Rhodes, Cyprus or southern Turkey. For a city break, almost anywhere in Europe works, and May is the last month before Rome and Seville get too hot. For long-haul, Bali and the Indian Ocean are the safest bets.

If you're choosing as a family or group and can't agree, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is hot in May half term?
faqs.answer: Crete, Paphos, Malta and Gozo, Madeira and Cape Verde are all warm enough for the beach. The sea is still cooling off after winter, so a heated pool helps.

faqs.question: Where is good for a city break in May?
faqs.answer: Almost anywhere in Europe: Barcelona, Rome, Paris, Prague, Vienna, Copenhagen, Kraków and Berlin are all at their best, with long days and outdoor tables. Further away, try New York, Boston or Washington, D.C.

faqs.question: What about somewhere further away in May?
faqs.answer: Jordan, Namibia, the Galápagos and Bali are all good in May. In the US, the Grand Canyon is warm without the summer heat.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in May?
faqs.answer: Seville, at around 28°C, and the Turkish and Greek coasts, around 25 to 26°C. Just outside Europe, Marrakech is around 29°C.

faqs.question: Is it warm enough to swim in the Mediterranean in May?
faqs.answer: By late May, for most people. The sea is around 18 to 20°C, warmest in the east around Cyprus and Turkey, and coolest in the north and west.

faqs.question: Is Greece hot in May?
faqs.answer: Warm rather than hot. Athens is around 26°C and the islands, such as Crete, Rhodes and Corfu, are around 24 to 25°C. It's one of the best months to visit.
